ThingDef.Name: EW2_WoodLogBase
ThingDef.description: Raw wood from a tree. Useful for building simple structures and weapons, it must be processed into fresh lumber and left to dry before becoming suitable for advanced projects. It is a good fuel for campfires and generators, and can be refined into chemfuel. In a pinch, a piece of wood can be used as a weapon or a leg.

ThingDef.label: bamboo stalks

Bamboo is a perishable, fast growing grass which develops wood like properties after processing.
